Item 1A. Risk Factors

Our business faces numerous risks including competition and supply constraints that could harm results. These risk factors are described to inform investors of potential adverse outcomes affecting the company.

Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

Revenue increased during the fiscal year driven by strong demand across our principal product lines. Management believes the improvement in gross margin reflects favorable pricing and disciplined cost control. We expect continued investment in research and development to support long-term growth, although macroeconomic uncertainty could pressure future results. Liquidity remains adequate to fund operations, capital expenditures, and return of capital to shareholders over the next twelve months.
